name: github-profile-readme-generator
description: Builds an animated GitHub profile README from your real GitHub data, after a few design questions.

plugins.name: github-profile
plugins.description: Design, preview and publish a GitHub profile README: SVG cards with live stats, 13 themes inspired by developer tools, editors, browsers, databases, git, operating systems and retro screens, light and dark modes, and an optional animated header from your own image or GIF.
